rationale_one_line: CLASSIC is tied-least-used (3/31) and not the most-recent framework (MANIFESTO), leaving room for a straightforward hook-proof-close arc that lets the real product beats (terminal, diagram) and the founder's own quote carry the story without a heavier structural conceit.
writing_tone_notes: Plain, confident, builder-to-builder. No hype adjectives -- let the real commands and the founder's own words do the work. Orange-on-near-black, JetBrainsMono display for a developer-tool register.
do_rules: lead every claim with something literally documented (command, architecture fact, or the founder's own quoted words)
keep it fast and snappy -- hard cuts, no stylized transition, matches the 'shipping fast' energy of a YC launch
dont_rules: no on-screen star count this run (variety gate: growth beat ran the last 2 videos)
don't over-explain MCP itself -- assume the audience already knows what the protocol is
